rendered:
The BA@HGNRs probe was centrifuged at a couple of points during preparation:
1. First, the CTAB-stabilized HGNRs were centrifuged at 6800 rpm, 10 min[1] and then redispersed in an equal volume of KOH solution.
2. After incubation with 4-MPBA[2], the mixture was centrifuged at 3600 rpm for 10 min[3]. It was then resuspended and concentrated in NH4HCO3 to give the BA@HGNRs probes.
The incubation step also lists a (300 rpm)[4] speed, but that is a slow-stirring rate, not a centrifugation.
